# SK ONE Tech Support

> Enterprise Managed IT Services, Cloud Infrastructure Migration, Custom Software Engineering & 24/7 SLA-Backed Tech Helpdesk.

SK ONE Tech Support (SKONE) delivers SLA-backed enterprise IT infrastructure management, zero-trust cybersecurity, custom full-stack software development, and dedicated developer staffing across India (Delhi NCR, Gurugram, Jaipur, Noida) and international enterprises.

## Core Capabilities

- [Managed IT Support](https://skonetechsupport.com/services): Enterprise Cisco network setups, firewall routing, workstation provisioning, server database maintenance, and 24/7 helpdesk support.
- [Cloud Infrastructure & Migration](https://skonetechsupport.com/services): End-to-end cloud migrations across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud (GCP) with Kubernetes container orchestration.
- [Custom Software Development](https://skonetechsupport.com/services): Bespoke React, Node.js, and Python web applications, CRM/ERP platforms, mobile apps, and database engineering.
- [Dedicated Developer Staffing](https://skonetechsupport.com/services): Pre-vetted contract software engineers and sysadmins with rapid 15-day scaling.

## Service Level Agreements (SLAs)

- [P1 Critical Support](https://skonetechsupport.com/contact): 30-minute response time for mission-critical infrastructure outages with 24/7 escalation engineers.
- [P2 High Priority Support](https://skonetechsupport.com/contact): 2-hour response time for severe performance degradation.
- [P3 General Support](https://skonetechsupport.com/contact): Same-day resolution for technical inquiries and routine configurations.
